column1: # The open findings the launch gate tolerates, one (contract, subject kind) per line; see
# check::KNOWN_FINDINGS. Shrink-only: CI fails a change that adds a line. Columns, tab-separated:
# contract, subject kind (`Subject::kind`), the regression test in tests/regressions/ that fixes it
# or `-`, and why it is open.

column4: listed since 6420a8baa with no cause recorded; not reached by the recent gate windows

the synchroniser, for a lost playback_finished, rotates to the next turn's first frame or text while the last segment still plays out: that segment's later progress moves the new segment's pacer, so words show before their audio (seeds 1906 3322 17865 22545 22658)

after 78f8da08f a continuation of a pending question (m0 continuing AST_r6) is answered by the continued task, but the durable rows disagree: the continued task's history lacks the reply and the receipt row is not merged into it, later failing on its own (A2A_SEED=154 239; 21 of 2048 seeds)

a batch runner's next drain pass resumes its lease through TakeLease, whose arrival-order rule refuses it behind an older interrupt/queue waiter, while the receive took the lease through TakeLeaseForMessage without that rule: the client is answered LeaseHeld and the lane stays held until the lease lapses (A2A_SEED=2 10 14; default policy map)
the same refused drain resume: the runner gives up with its own message still pending in the inbox and no other waiter drains it (A2A_SEED=19 26 46)

the drain rebuilds each inbox message with its own receipt task as taskId (Message::from_a2a(.., Some(tid))), so pending_ask looks for that task: a batched message neither continues nor merges the waiting question and asks its own (A2A_SEED=36 43 54)

the door checks a follow-up's taskId before the turn waits for the lane; a turn ahead merges that task, so pending_ask(named) finds nothing and the waiting question is left beside the new one (A2A_SEED=68 88 130)
reject writes its row with submit and ignores that a resent messageId inserted nothing: the resend is answered an unwritten failed task instead of the message's task (A2A_SEED=0 13 35)

overlapping concurrent turns both claim one pending question (no lease, no conditional claim): the second's terminal write is dropped and its client is answered the first's outcome (A2A_SEED=181 350 616)
a concurrent run reads a row a client canceled mid-turn as its write base; merge_write refuses the terminal row and the client is answered Invalid (A2A_SEED=50 60 267)
concurrent does no pickup, so a message whose task a client canceled before its turn still runs and its answer lands on the task it continued (A2A_SEED=103 189 662)
